hero_slides.subtext: Hand-bound journals, jute diaries, and bamboo pens crafted with care.
Highlighters, geometry sets, and essential desk tools ready for test day.
Block-printed gift wraps, washi tapes, and premium printing reams.

products.name: Classic Ruled School Notebook
products.description: Sturdy bound notebook featuring smooth 70 GSM off-white lined paper. Designed with reinforced stitching to withstand daily school and college use. Includes a personal details front page and subject divider margins.

products.name: Hardcover Cloth-Bound Journal
products.description: Elegant bookcloth hardcover journal filled with bleed-resistant 100 GSM ivory pages. Opens flat at 180 degrees for comfortable two-page writing and note taking. Finished with an elastic closure band and dual satin ribbon page markers.

products.name: Hand-Pressed Jute Fiber Diary
products.description: Artisanal diary bound in textured natural jute weave with a wrap-around cord closure. Contains thick deckle-edge cotton rag paper suitable for calligraphy, sketching, and fountain pens. Handcrafted by local paper artisans using traditional hand-loom fibers.

products.name: Twin-Wire Spiral Lecture Notebook
products.description: Flexible poly-cover notebook with durable twin-wire binding that allows 360-degree rotation. Features micro-perforated ruled sheets for clean page removal. Ideal for fast university lectures and daily task journaling.

products.name: Hardcover Cloth-Bound Ledger Register
products.description: Traditional hardcover ledger book bound in durable red book-cloth. Ruled with precise red and blue ledger margins for accounting and records. 80 GSM ink-resistant paper prevents feathering and bleed-through for archival preservation.

products.name: Lokta Heritage Botanical Journal
products.description: Traditional sun-dried lokta bush paper bound in cotton bookcloth. Each page displays subtle natural petal flecks and distinctive textural grain. Finished with a sturdy stitched spine that opens flat for journaling and calligraphy.

products.name: Pocket Memo Notepad Pack
products.description: Compact top-stapled pocket notepads engineered for quick field reminders and shopping lists. Made with water-resistant kraft paper covers and clean micro-grid paper. Fits effortlessly into shirt pockets and small pouches.

products.name: Smooth-Glide Ballpoint Pen
products.description: Dependable 0.7mm tungsten-carbide tip ballpoint pen with quick-dry oil-based ink. Ergonomic grooved rubber grip prevents finger fatigue during lengthy exam sessions. Transparent hexagonal barrel allows instant ink-level checks.

products.name: Everyday Retractable Gel Pen 5-Pack
products.description: Pack of five 0.5mm needle-point retractable gel pens delivering crisp dark strokes. Fast-drying smudge-free ink formula prevents blurring on porous paper. Built with a spring-loaded metal pocket clip for easy transport.

products.name: Turned Bamboo Rollerball Pen
products.description: Solid hand-turned natural bamboo casing fitted with antique brass finish metal hardware. Uses international standard ceramic rollerball refills for fluid friction-free writing. Presented in a matching magnetic bamboo gift presentation box.

products.name: Natural Graphite Writing Pencil
products.description: Hexagonal cedarwood writing pencil loaded with break-resistant HB graphite lead. Provides uniform tonal shading and effortless sharpening with standard sharpeners. Finished with a smooth matte green lacquer coating and dipped crown end.

products.name: Dry-Erase Whiteboard Marker 4-Pack
products.description: Four-color dry-erase marker set containing black, blue, red, and green bullet-tip pens. Formulated with alcohol-based low-odor ink that wipes off dry-erase boards cleanly with a standard felt eraser. Suitable for classroom teaching, office meetings, and presentation boards.
image_labels: Set of Four Color Whiteboard Markers

products.name: Fine-Liner Technical Drawing Pen Set
products.description: Pigmented black ink technical pens with durable metal-clad fine tips. Formulated for precision architectural drawings, line art, and detailed journal outlines. Quick-drying ink resists feathering on standard paper and allows clean line definition under ink washes.

products.name: Brushed Steel Fountain Pen
products.description: Weighted brushed stainless steel fountain pen sporting a polished fine iridium nib. Compatible with standard international cartridges or the included rotary piston converter. Delivers consistent ink flow suited for formal document signing and journaling.

products.name: Artist Pre-Sharpened Colored Pencils
products.description: Soft-core wax-based colored pencils offering rich color saturation and smooth blending. Enclosed in a compact protective embossed tin case for portable field sketching. Pre-sharpened 3.3mm cores resist shattering under medium drawing pressure.

products.name: Compact Watercolor Cake Palette
products.description: Set of 18 rich pigment watercolor cakes in a pocket-sized travel palette with mixing wells. Includes a mini refillable water brush pen and sponge for painting outdoors. Water-soluble cakes dissolve cleanly with vivid transparency on watercolor paper.

products.name: Heavyweight Mixed Media Sketchbook
products.description: Wire-bound hardcover sketchbook featuring 200 GSM heavy rough tooth watercolor paper. Handles gouache, ink washes, dry pastels, and graphite without buckling or warping. Contains 40 perforated micro-sheet pages with sturdy protective chipboard backing.

products.name: Dual-Tip Alcohol Art Marker 6-Pack
products.description: Versatile illustration markers featuring a flexible brush tip on one end and broad chisel on the other. Quick-drying alcohol ink blends seamlessly without streak marks on marker paper. Comes in a clear reusable tabletop standing plastic case.

products.name: Studio Acrylic Paint Tube Starter Set
products.description: Twelve 22ml tubes of high-viscosity acrylic paint offering a rich satin finish. Suitable for canvas boards, terracotta, primed wood, and heavyweight paper. Mixes cleanly to produce a broad spectrum of rich intermediate tones.
products.image_label: Studio Acrylic Paint Tube Starter Set

products.name: Fine Detail Round Watercolor Brush
products.description: Synthetic golden Taklon hair round brush offering superior snap and excellent paint holding belly. Nickel-plated seamless brass ferrule crimped securely to a balanced lacquered wooden handle. Designed for intricate botanical lines and precise detail rendering.

products.name: Multipurpose A4 Copy Paper Ream
products.description: Standard 500-sheet ream of 80 GSM high-opacity copy paper for inkjet and laser printers. Engineered for continuous high-speed printing and sharp text reproduction. Balanced paper formulation maintains page brightness during long-term file archiving.

products.name: Pastel Colored Craft Paper 50-Pack
products.description: Assortment of fifty sheets of 80 GSM dyed pastel paper in soft yellow, pink, green, and blue. Ideal for origami crafts, classroom activities, scrapbooking, and colorful office dividers. Paper cuts cleanly with standard craft scissors and paper punches.

products.name: Matte Printable Adhesive Sticker Paper
products.description: Full-sheet self-adhesive A4 paper with a matte finish designed for inkjet and laser printing. Peel-and-stick backing features easy-split score lines for quick label application. Ink absorbs quickly without bleeding, making it optimal for custom shipping labels and decals.

products.name: Heavyweight Cardstock Paper 25-Pack
products.description: Pack of twenty-five 220 GSM thick white cardstock sheets engineered for brochures and report covers. Compatible with heavy-duty paper feeds and scoring tools for custom greetings. Smooth satin surface holds pigment inks and ballpoint pens without feathering.

products.name: Peel-and-Seal Mailing Envelope Pack
products.description: Pack of twenty-five eighty GSM white paper mailing envelopes with self-adhesive peel-and-seal flap closures. Features an internal security pattern print to keep letters, invoices, and certificates confidential during transit. Suitable for business correspondence, official documentation, and invitation deliveries.
image_labels: Security Tinted Peel and Seal Envelopes

products.name: Super-Bright Recycled Office Paper Ream
products.description: High-opacity 75 GSM paper engineered for everyday office copying and draft double-sided documentation. Features smooth surface texture calibrated for high-speed laser and inkjet printing without paper jams. Packaged in a protective moisture-barrier wrapper containing five hundred precision-cut sheets.

products.name: Compact All-Metal Desktop Stapler
products.description: Heavy-duty steel chassis stapler capable of fastening up to 25 sheets of 80 GSM paper with ease. Features a reversible anvil for permanent fastening or temporary paper tacking. Fitted with a non-skid rubberized base pad that prevents desktop scratching.

products.name: Heavy-Duty Metal Two-Hole Punch with Integrated Paper Guide and Waste Confetti Compartment
products.description: All-metal manual desktop paper hole punch engineered with dual hardened steel punch heads capable of perforating up to thirty sheets of standard eighty GSM copy paper in a single downward pressing stroke. Fitted with an extendable graduated centering paper guide ruler that locks into standard page sizes to guarantee consistent symmetrical double-punched binder holes across filing cabinets and ring folders. The textured non-skid rubber base protects polished office desk surfaces during heavy document preparation while doubling as a flip-open waste tray that catches paper confetti circles for fast cleanup.
image_labels: Steel Two-Hole Punch with Margin Guide

products.name: Clear Cellulose Stationery Tape
products.description: Transparent plant-derived cellulose adhesive tape designed for clean document mending and gift wrapping. Unwinds smoothly from standard 1-inch core desktop dispensers without splitting or curling. Pressure-sensitive adhesive bonds instantly to paper, cardboard, and light plastic.

products.name: Stainless Steel Ergonomic Office Scissors
products.description: Seven-inch precision-ground stainless steel scissors suitable for paper, cardstock, and fabric craft. Ergonomic soft-grip handles allow ambidextrous cutting comfort for left and right-handed users. Heavy-duty pivot screw ensures blade alignment and crisp cuts along the entire blade edge.

products.name: Felt Surface Document Ink Stamp Pad
products.description: Classic metal-cased office ink pad filled with dense water-based stamping ink. The high-density woven felt pad delivers crisp impressions without flooding rubber stamp lettering or seal borders. Fitted with an airtight snap-closure lid that prevents ink evaporation during storage on office desks.
products.image_label: Felt Surface Document Ink Stamp Pad

products.name: Expanding Poly Document File Folder
products.description: Multi-pocket durable polypropylene folder equipped with tabbed divider sleeves and color insert labels. Elastic cord with button latch secures up to 200 A4 document pages for transport. Water-resistant wipe-clean material protects vital receipts, bills, and certificates.

products.name: Steel Wire Mesh Desktop Organizer
products.description: Powder-coated steel mesh caddy designed to tidy pens, sticky pads, clips, and office scissors. Sturdy perforated metal construction provides visibility while resisting dust accumulation. Fitted with protective rubber feet to safeguard wooden desks from scuffs.

products.name: Complete Student Metal Geometry Box
products.description: Nine-piece mathematical instrument set packed in a classic illustrated metal tin box. Contains metal die-cast compass, divider, 15cm ruler, 180-degree protractor, set squares, mini pencil, and eraser. Calibrated metric markings provide clear legibility for technical school examinations.

products.name: Shatter-Resistant Clear Acrylic Ruler
products.description: Transparent acrylic measuring ruler with dual-edge millimeter and centimeter graduation marks. Beveled drawing edge prevents ink dragging and smudging when ruling technical lines. Built from flexible shatter-resistant plastic that survives accidental drops in classrooms.

products.name: Quick-Drying Correction Fluid Bottle with Foam Applicator
products.description: Fast-drying white opaque fluid formulated for covering ink mistakes on written and printed documents. Features a wedge-shaped foam applicator tip for precise spot corrections and full-line coverage. Dispenses smoothly from a spill-resistant twenty milliliter plastic bottle.
image_labels: White Correction Fluid Bottle with Foam Tip

products.name: Multi-Function Advanced Scientific Calculator
products.description: Two-line textbook display scientific calculator equipped with 240 integrated math and engineering functions. Performs fraction calculations, coordinate conversions, permutations, combinations, and statistics. Hard slide-on protective case prevents screen scratches during backpack transport.

products.name: Dust-Free Eraser and Metal Sharpener Combo Pack
products.description: Compact desk set containing two soft vinyl erasers and one twin-hole metal pencil sharpener. The erasers roll up graphite pencil markings cleanly into single strands without tearing paper fibers. High-carbon steel sharpener blades produce smooth pencil points for standard and jumbo pencils.
products.image_label: Dust-Free Eraser and Metal Sharpener Combo Pack
image_labels: Vinyl Erasers and Dual Metal Sharpener

products.name: Hand-Block Printed Floral Gift Wrap
products.description: Heavyweight 90 GSM kraft wrapping paper hand-stamped with traditional carved wooden blocks. Delivers a rustic artisanal charm to festival presents, wedding favors, and holiday packages. Each large sheet measures 70x50 cm and folds cleanly along crisp package corners.

products.name: Letterpress Botanical Congratulations Card
products.description: Heavy 300 GSM cotton rag card deeply debossed on a traditional mechanical platen press. Paired with a matching gummed peel-and-seal kraft envelope. Blank inside to welcome handwritten congratulatory messages and warm seasonal wishes.

products.name: Decorative Botanical Washi Tape Set
products.description: Rice-paper-style decorative masking tapes featuring watercolor leaf and floral foliage patterns. Peels and repositions effortlessly without tearing paper surfaces or leaving sticky residue. Suitable for bullet journal borders, greeting card borders, and craft gift accents.

products.name: Reinforced Kraft Paper Gift Bag Bundle
products.description: Bundle of three durable brown kraft paper gift bags with twisted paper handles. Reinforced cardboard bottom insert maintains bag shape when carrying books and stationery sets. Can be personalized using stamps, calligraphy pens, or decorative washi tapes.
products.image_label: Reinforced Kraft Paper Gift Bag Bundle

products.name: Embossed Calligraphy Greeting Card Pack
products.description: Four-pack of celebration greeting cards finished with tactile raised gold foil embossing. Printed on three hundred GSM ivory cardstock with matching pastel envelopes. Designed with blank interiors for personal congratulations, milestones, and festival greetings.

products.name: Foil-Accented Metallic Craft Washi Tape
products.description: Shimmering copper and silver hot-stamped masking tape designed for decorative journaling and gift borders. Repositionable rice-paper-style base tears cleanly by hand without scissors. Leaves clean paper surfaces upon removal without sticky adhesive residue.

products.name: Pastel Chisel-Tip Highlighter Set
products.description: Soft muted pastel highlighters that mark important study notes without obscuring text. Water-based ink formula resists bleeding through standard textbook pages and thin notebook paper. Versatile chisel nib delivers both 1mm fine underlining and 4mm broad highlighting.

products.name: Self-Adhesive Repositionable Sticky Notes
products.description: Square 3x3 inch memo pads coated with dependable repositionable adhesive along the top edge. Adheres reliably to laptop monitors, textbook margins, whiteboards, and desk surfaces. Removes cleanly without tearing paper or leaving gummy adhesive marks.

products.name: Vinyl-Coated Rustproof Paper Clips 100-Pack
products.description: One hundred 28mm spring-steel wire paper clips coated in smooth assorted vinyl colors. Rounded edges glide easily over paper sheets without scratching or tearing confidential exams. Protective coating shields the internal steel from humidity and prevents corrosion.

products.name: Transparent Exam Clipboard with Storage Pocket
products.description: Rigid shatter-resistant clear acrylic clipboard designed for holding examination sheets and writing pads. Features a low-profile metal wire spring clip with rubberized corner grips to firmly clamp papers. Includes a transparent rear sleeve to slide admission forms, timetables, and student ID cards.
products.image_label: Transparent Exam Clipboard with Storage Pocket

products.name: Clear Zippered Exam Pencil Case
products.description: Transparent heavy-gauge clear vinyl pencil case providing direct visibility of enclosed stationery. Fitted with a nylon zipper and smooth-glide metal pull to hold pens, rulers, and geometry tools. Flexible plastic construction easily wipes clean and withstands repeated school use.

products.name: A4 Ruled Exam Writing Pad with Margins
products.description: Specialized A4 examination writing pad designed for university, college, and school practice. Standard pre-printed 1.5-inch margins along the left and top edges. 70 GSM smooth off-white paper optimized for effortless fast writing with ballpoint and gel pens.
products.image_label: A4 Ruled Exam Writing Pad with Margins
